reviewer: Kimi independent actual visual comparison of the exact 65x67 source PNG, enlarged existing source-page 12 and targeted source-note crop, complete unchanged external-02 2048x2048 raw RGBA and native note/right-edge crop, full repair-agent white/cyan/alpha sheet and evidence, and unchanged naiwa.png; verified the restored dark right tab, removal of the old isolated lower-left dot, two compact upper rows, frontal cap portrait, uniform, collar, backing and transparency.

entries.positive_observation: The external-02 note retains TWO compact upper rows of irregular, variably sized gray groups and mostly blank lower paper; the prior isolated lower-left gray dot is gone, with no third mark row. A dark right-edge tab is restored in its expected edge position. The dark navy cap retains its glossy visor, gold cord, separate small upper emblem and lower circular wreath/cockade. Covered hair, dark brows, no glasses, no moustache or beard and one stern closed mouth remain. The strictly frontal upright pose, direct gaze, crop and visor shadow remain. The dark navy jacket keeps gold shoulder accents, white pointed collar and dark tie, with a short broad fitted neck and no stalk or pinching. The complete dark frame and opaque muted olive-grey backplate remain. Full white/cyan inspection shows a genuine transparent exterior with no visible interior holes, lost backing or working-matte ring.
entries.alpha_decision: Accept native RGBA extrema 0..254 after actual white/cyan/alpha viewing; no source-alpha replacement was performed or needed, and 252-254 values alone were not rejection grounds.
entries.visible_limitations: Internal cap-badge details, shoulder embroidery and exact note glyph shapes are not reliably readable at 65x67; the review verifies the visible two-row upper footprint, absence of the old lower-left dot, edge-tab structure and portrait features rather than transcribing microscopic emblems or lettering.
